name: OCaml
typeSystem: Static, strong, inferred (Hindley-Milner), algebraic data types
runtime: Compiled to native (ocamlopt) or bytecode (ocamlc), with GC
concurrencyModel: OCaml 5: multicore via domains + effect handlers; pre-5: single-domain with Lwt/Async

codeExample.source:
let rec fib = function
  | 0 -> 0
  | 1 -> 1
  | n -> fib (n - 1) + fib (n - 2)

let () =
  List.init 10 Fun.id
  |> List.map fib
  |> List.iter (Printf.printf "%d ")
  |> print_newline
